items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Great guy to work for. And a man, you know, really a man.

ctx.x: Oh, he's a wonderful guy. Oh, yeah, when I went in business on Clayman Street, he used to come down and see me. Oh, and every time he wanted me to come over and see, you know, to stop over, he said, stop over and see me. Well, at that time, they went after, see, they had a fire on Ramport Street. And they got a lot of damage to start getting, and they moved in a location around, I think it was Perdita and Drive, the Dread and Drive, upstairs. We handled the business there for a while, and then I decided I wanted…
And who was your, did any of those pupils ever become famous? From the Morris Music School?
